carry.a: Carry is always an estimate: spin is not measured and wind is ignored. It is most useful for comparing your own swings with each other.

ci.a: It is a 95% confidence interval: the true value is inside that range about 95% of the time. The narrower the range, the more reliable the number.

data.a: Only in this phone's browser. There is no account and nothing is uploaded. Back up in History before you change phones or clear data.

eviction.a: If the app is not opened for a while, iPhone may delete website data. Adding it to your Home Screen and turning on protection under Storage makes this less likely; please also back up regularly.

modes.a: Live mode analyses tempo and body movement straight from the camera. For ball speed, launch and carry, record in iPhone slow motion and import the video from Files.
modes.q: What is the difference between live mode and slow-motion import?

null.a: When a number cannot be measured from this angle or this video, it shows — with the reason instead of a guess. Another camera angle can usually measure it.

offline.a: Only to download the app the first time (about 32 MB). Practice, analysis and results work without a connection after that.
offline.q: Do I need an internet connection?

phases.a: By rules that follow your wrists and body to find address, the top of the swing, impact and the rest. If one is wrong you can correct it on the result screen.
phases.q: How are the swing phases found?

placement.a: On a tripod, outside the swing path. The first setup step draws the distance and height for your venue. Measure the mat the first time you use a venue.

glossary.hint: What each number on the result screen means, and the range most amateurs see.
glossary.title: Glossary

report.body: Open an issue on GitHub; you can attach the report from Diagnostics. The app never sends anything by itself.
report.title: Report a problem

legal.carry: Carry comes from a model: spin is not measured (a typical value for the club is used) and wind is ignored.
legal.estimates: The numbers are estimates for practice. This app is not a certified launch monitor.
legal.ranges: The ± after a number is a 95% confidence interval: the true value is inside that range about 95% of the time. A number that cannot be measured shows — with the reason; it is never guessed.

safety.people: Make sure nobody is near you before you swing, and don't look at the phone while swinging.
safety.title: Safety
safety.tripod: Put the tripod outside the swing path, ideally behind the bay partition. Make a practice swing first to check you cannot hit it.

legal.title: Disclaimer
legal.views: Numbers measured from different camera angles are not directly comparable; comparisons say so.

attack_angle_deg.label: Attack angle
attack_angle_deg.meaning: Club moving down (negative) or up (positive) at impact.
attack_angle_deg.range: Irons about −5° to −2°; driver about −1° to +4°

backswing_s.label: Backswing time
backswing_s.meaning: Time from address to the top of the swing.

ball_speed_mps.label: Ball speed
ball_speed_mps.meaning: Speed of the ball as it leaves the club face.

carry_m.label: Carry
carry_m.meaning: Distance the ball flies through the air (no roll).

carry_side_m.label: Carry side
carry_side_m.meaning: How far left or right of the target line the ball lands (estimated).

club_path_deg.label: Club path
club_path_deg.meaning: In-to-out (positive) or out-to-in (negative) direction of the club at impact.

club_speed_mps.label: Club speed
club_speed_mps.meaning: Speed of the club head at impact.

curve_m.label: Curve
curve_m.meaning: Sideways bend of the flight from its start line (estimated).

downswing_s.label: Downswing time
downswing_s.meaning: Time from the top of the swing to impact.

dynamic_loft_deg.label: Dynamic loft
dynamic_loft_deg.meaning: Loft of the club face at impact (estimated).

early_extension_m.label: Early extension
early_extension_m.meaning: How far your pelvis moves toward the ball in the downswing.

face_angle_deg.label: Face angle
face_angle_deg.meaning: Face open (positive) or closed (negative) to the target at impact (estimated).

face_to_path_deg.label: Face to path
face_to_path_deg.meaning: Face angle relative to the club path; sets the curve (estimated).

hand_plane_dev_m.label: Hand plane deviation
hand_plane_dev_m.meaning: How far your hands move off the shaft plane.

head_depth_y_m.label: Head depth
head_depth_y_m.meaning: How far your head moves toward or away from the ball.

head_lift_z_m.label: Head lift
head_lift_z_m.meaning: How far your head rises or drops during the swing.

head_sway_x_m.label: Head sway
head_sway_x_m.meaning: How far your head moves along the target line during the swing.
head_sway_x_m.range: Smaller is steadier; within about 5 cm

hip_turn_deg.label: Hip turn
hip_turn_deg.meaning: How far your hips turn at the top.

landing_angle_deg.label: Landing angle
landing_angle_deg.meaning: Angle at which the ball comes down (estimated).

launch_h_deg.label: Start direction
launch_h_deg.meaning: Left or right direction in which the ball starts.

launch_v_deg.label: Launch angle
launch_v_deg.meaning: Vertical angle at which the ball takes off.

shoulder_turn_deg.label: Shoulder turn
shoulder_turn_deg.meaning: How far your shoulders turn at the top.

smash_factor.label: Smash factor
smash_factor.meaning: Ball speed divided by club speed.

spin_axis_deg.label: Spin axis
spin_axis_deg.meaning: Tilt of the spin axis; positive curves right for a right-hander (estimated).

spin_loft_deg.label: Spin loft
spin_loft_deg.meaning: Angle between the face and the club path at impact (estimated).

spine_forward_tilt_deg.label: Spine tilt (forward)
spine_forward_tilt_deg.meaning: How far your upper body bends forward at address.

spine_side_tilt_deg.label: Spine tilt (side)
spine_side_tilt_deg.meaning: How far your upper body leans to the side at address.

tempo_ratio.label: Tempo
tempo_ratio.meaning: Backswing time divided by downswing time.
tempo_ratio.range: Most good players are close to 3.0

top_shaft_angle_deg.label: Shaft at the top
top_shaft_angle_deg.meaning: Direction of the shaft at the top of the swing.
top_shaft_angle_deg.range: Close to parallel to the target line

total_side_m.label: Total side
total_side_m.meaning: How far left or right of the target line the ball stops (estimated).

weight_shift_pct.label: Weight shift
weight_shift_pct.meaning: Pelvis movement as a share of your stance width (estimate).
weight_shift_pct.range: Moves toward the lead foot by impact

backup.body: History can save your data as one file, wherever you choose. The app never uploads or shares anything on its own.
backup.title: Backups are up to you

privacy.lead: Your swing belongs to you. This app has no server and collects no data.

local.body: Videos, poses, results, venues and settings are kept in this browser's storage on this phone, and nowhere else.

AUDIO_UNAVAILABLE.long: No microphone, so the moment of impact is estimated from wrist speed.

BODY_PLANE_ASSUMED.fix: Stand on the mat when you hit.
BODY_PLANE_ASSUMED.long: Your ankles are not on the mat, so the distance to your body is assumed.

CALIB_STALE.long: The mat is not where it was during calibration (the camera or mat moved).

CLIP_NOT_SAVED.fix: Free up space in Settings › Storage.
CLIP_NOT_SAVED.long: The phone is low on space, so this shot’s video was not saved (numbers and pose were saved).

CROSS_VIEW_PRIOR.fix: This is not a measurement of this shot; use it as a guide only.
CROSS_VIEW_PRIOR.long: Uses the recent face-on average for the same club (not measured on this shot).

DEPENDS_ON_NULL.fix: Get ball speed and launch angle measured first.
DEPENDS_ON_NULL.long: This number depends on other numbers that could not be measured.

DEPTH_DRIFT_SUSPECT.fix: Keep the ball centred and at the same distance from the camera, then record again.
DEPTH_DRIFT_SUSPECT.long: The ball started far off line or the fit is poor, so depth may be inaccurate.

DPLANE_MODEL.fix: Use it as a guide; keep the camera position and calibration steady for better numbers.
DPLANE_MODEL.long: Worked back from the start direction or launch angle and the club data with the D-plane model; not measured directly.

EVENTS_UNCERTAIN.fix: Check or correct the swing positions in the replay.
EVENTS_UNCERTAIN.long: The swing positions could not be timed reliably.

FLIGHT_MODELLED.fix: Use it as a guide; distances may be off by a fixed amount.
FLIGHT_MODELLED.long: The flight is simulated with an aerodynamic model that has not yet been checked against a launch monitor.

FPS_TOO_LOW.fix: Record in slow motion (240 fps) and import the video.
FPS_TOO_LOW.long: The frame rate is too low (ball numbers need slow-motion video of at least 200 fps).

IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUE.fix: Check the setup and calibration, then record again.
IMPLAUSIBLE_VALUE.long: The result was outside a realistic range and was discarded.

LAUNCH_DIR_UNOBSERVABLE.fix: Film from high behind to see the start direction.
LAUNCH_DIR_UNOBSERVABLE.long: This angle cannot see whether the ball starts left or right.

LAUNCH_V_ASSUMED.fix: Film from the face-on position to measure the launch angle.
LAUNCH_V_ASSUMED.long: This camera position cannot measure the launch angle; a typical value for the club is used.

MIGRATED_V1.fix: Open the result and use recompute with the new model; for attack angle, analyse the swing again from its video.
MIGRATED_V1.long: This record comes from an older version that did not compute this number. Most of these can be recomputed with the new model; a number that needs the original video (attack angle) stays empty.

NOT_IMPLEMENTED.fix: A later version will add it.
NOT_IMPLEMENTED.long: This version does not provide this number yet.

NO_CALIBRATION.fix: Finish setup at the venue first, then import videos from the same camera position.
NO_CALIBRATION.long: This video has no mat calibration, so ball and club numbers cannot be turned into real distances.

NO_GRAVITY_REF.long: No level sensor data; camera tilt is estimated from the mat only.

OUT_OF_FRAME.fix: Move the phone back so the whole swing fits.
OUT_OF_FRAME.long: A body part or the club head needed for this number was outside the frame.

POSE_LOW_VISIBILITY.fix: Keep your whole body in frame, in good light, and avoid loose clothing.
POSE_LOW_VISIBILITY.long: Key points of your body were hard to see.

PRESET_MISMATCH.fix: Compare shots filmed from the same position.
PRESET_MISMATCH.long: The two shots being compared were filmed from different camera positions.

ROLLING_SHUTTER_ASSUMED.fix: Run the shutter measurement in Diagnostics for better numbers.
ROLLING_SHUTTER_ASSUMED.long: Rolling-shutter readout time is corrected with an assumed value.

ROLL_MODELLED.fix: Set the ground firmness in Settings.
ROLL_MODELLED.long: Roll after landing is estimated from the landing angle and the ground firmness.

SETUP_UNVERIFIED.fix: Go back to setup and finish the checks.
SETUP_UNVERIFIED.long: Practice started before every setup check passed.

SLOWMO_CORRECTED.long: This video was saved as slow-motion playback; its speed was corrected automatically.

SMASH_ASSUMED.fix: Film from the face-on position to measure ball speed.
SMASH_ASSUMED.long: Ball speed is club speed times a typical smash factor for the club; not measured directly.

SPIN_ASSUMED.fix: Check that the right club is selected; treat the distance as a guide.
SPIN_ASSUMED.long: Spin is not measured; a typical value for the club is used.

SPIN_LOFT_ASSUMED.fix: Check that the right club is selected.
SPIN_LOFT_ASSUMED.long: This camera position cannot measure spin loft; a typical value for the club is used.

SPIN_MODELLED.fix: Use it as a guide and check that the right club is selected.
SPIN_MODELLED.long: Spin is worked out from spin loft and club speed with an impact model, blended with typical values for the club.

TEE_LIFT_ASSUMED.fix: Measure the tee height once in the venue settings.
TEE_LIFT_ASSUMED.long: Tee height was not measured; a typical value is used.

THERMAL_DEGRADED.fix: Let the phone cool down and keep it out of direct sun.
THERMAL_DEGRADED.long: The phone was hot or slow, so analysis accuracy was lowered automatically.

TIMEBASE_SUSPECT.fix: Import the original camera file and try again.
TIMEBASE_SUSPECT.long: The downswing time is not plausible; the video may have been converted or re-timed.

TIMESTAMPS_NOMINAL.fix: Import the original camera file, not an edited or converted copy.
TIMESTAMPS_NOMINAL.long: The video has no reliable timestamps, so its nominal frame rate is used.

TRACK_MAY_BE_SHORT.fix: Move the phone back a little or use a wider view.
TRACK_MAY_BE_SHORT.long: With this setup a fast ball may be visible in only a few frames (just a heads-up).
TRACK_MAY_BE_SHORT.short: Ball may leave the frame quickly

TRACK_TOO_SHORT.fix: Keep the ball flight inside the frame and make sure the bay is well lit.
TRACK_TOO_SHORT.long: The ball or club head was found in too few frames (fewer than 5).

VIEW_DEPTH_AXIS.fix: Film from another angle (for example down the line) to get it.
VIEW_DEPTH_AXIS.long: This angle cannot see depth along the camera axis, so this number cannot be measured.

VIEW_PLANE_MISMATCH.fix: Film from another angle to get it.
VIEW_PLANE_MISMATCH.long: The movement for this number is not square to the camera, so this angle cannot measure it.

WIND_IGNORED.fix: On a windy day treat distances as a guide.
WIND_IGNORED.long: Wind is not taken into account.
